messages.author: 9092d48c28a976e1
messages.subject: setting shiny server up on Ubuntu 12.04?
parts:
I am trying to set shiny server up for the first time. The OS is a newly installed (and updated) Unbuntu 12.04 on a box with a fixed IP address and R 2.15 installed. I have an apache server running, and I can see the box from another computer outside my local domain fine. To try to set up the shiny server I followed the directions at: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Ubuntu-step-by-step-install-instructions. 
All goes well, until I try to start the shiny server. I get an error: "start: Unknown job: shiney-server".

I posted the tutorial examples to the server in the /var/.../www directory for shiny, and, not surprisingly, I can't connect to the examples. To check that it isn't a firewall issue, I turned the firewall off temporarily, and I still can't connect to the shiny server, even when I attempt to start the shiny server manually first:

>/var/shiny-server/www$ sudo shiny-server
[2013-04-27 21:44:16.022] [INFO] shiny-server - Shiny Server v0.3.5 (Node.js v0.10.5)
[2013-04-27 21:44:16.024] [INFO] shiny-server - Using config file "/usr/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/config/default.config"
[2013-04-27 21:44:16.049] [INFO] shiny-server - Starting listener on 0.0.0.0:3838

I'm still not able to connect after this.

I'm sure there is probably something simple (and silly) I'm missing, but does anyone else running shiny server on Ubuntu 12.04 (or anywhere else for that matter) have any suggestions?

Summary:
OS: Ubuntu 12.04
R: 2.15
Shiny Server: 0.3.5
Node.js: 0.10.5
Firewall: Either off or on with port 3838 open (doesn't work either way)


Thank you.
Seth

messages.subject: Re: setting shiny server up on Ubuntu 12.04?
parts:
shiny-server.conf was there, but it didn't agree with what I saw at the link. I manually entered shiny-server.conf and started the shiny server. This time is started:

>:/var/shiny-server/www/example$ sudo start shiny-server
shiny-server start/running, process 24818

However, I still can't connect. I can connect to the server more generally (http, ssh, etc.), but when I go to http://<server name>:3838/examples/ I get a cannot connect error, even with the firewall off. I reinstalled the shiny server this morning, double-checked shiny-server.conf, and restarted the shiny-server.

When I look at the open ports and at what is listening on different ports, I don't see shiny-server, and I don't see 3838 open.

Suggestions? Thank you!

messages.subject: Re: setting shiny server up on Ubuntu 12.04?
parts:
I had identical problems. For others having this problem -- what got the examples showing up for me were these things..
  • when installing shiny-server, making sure it installed as a global package i.e. including the -g when doing sudo npm install -g shiny-server
  • making sure inbound TCP connections through port 3838 (if thats what you're using) are allowed:
    sudo ufw allow 3838/tcp
As a newbie myself, I can't really speak to why those worked for me but after tripping and falling around with the same problems above that was what eventually worked... good luck!
